title: j-andrews7/microcrcmc pipeline parameters
description: Micro-C and RCMC processing pipeline - alignment, pairs, contact maps (mcool) and mustache loop calling

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.description: Path to comma-separated file containing information about the samples in the experiment.
input.help_text: Comma-separated (or tab-separated) file with a header row and the columns `sample`, `fastq_1`, `fastq_2`, `replicate` and `lane`. `sample` is the experimental condition (the `condition` column of the original Snakemake `samples.tsv`). See `docs/usage.md`.

contrasts.description: Optional CSV with `condition1,condition2` columns listing differential loop comparisons. Implies `--diff_loops`.
contrasts.help_text: Each row runs `diff_mustache` between the condition-merged maps of `condition1` and `condition2`. If `--diff_loops` is set and no contrasts file is given, all pairwise comparisons between conditions (in samplesheet order) are run.

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved. You have to use absolute paths to storage on Cloud infrastructure.

email.help_text: Set this parameter to your e-mail address to get a summary e-mail with details of the run sent to you when the workflow exits. If set in your user config file (`~/.nextflow/config`) then you don't need to specify this on the command line for every run.

multiqc_title.description: MultiQC report title. Printed as page header, used for filename if not otherwise specified.

reference_genome_options.title: Reference genome options
reference_genome_options.description: Reference genome, bwa-mem2 index and chromosome sizes.

fasta.description: Path to the genome FASTA file (optionally gzipped).
fasta.help_text: Used to build a bwa-mem2 index if `--bwamem2_index` is not given. If a bwa-mem2 index already exists next to the FASTA (e.g. `genome.fa.gz.0123`, `.amb`, `.ann`, `.bwt.2bit.64`, `.pac`, as created by the original Snakemake pipeline) it is reused automatically.

bwamem2_index.description: Path to a directory containing a single pre-built bwa-mem2 index.
bwamem2_index.help_text: For example the `genome/bwamem2` folder saved by a previous run with `--save_reference`.

chromsizes.description: Tab-delimited chromosome sizes file (chrom, length) in natural sort order, major chromosomes only.
chromsizes.help_text: Same file as the `chromsizes` entry of the original `config.yaml`.

assembly.description: Name of the genome assembly (e.g. hg19, hg38, mm10, mm39).

save_reference.description: Save the bwa-mem2 index built by the pipeline to `<outdir>/genome` for reuse.

processing_options.title: Processing options
processing_options.description: Options that mirror the original Snakemake `config.yaml`, plus alignment chunking.

resolutions.description: Comma-separated resolutions (bp) to bin contact maps to. All must be integer multiples of the smallest.

regions.description: RCMC mode: BED file (chrom, start, end; no header) with the captured regions. Leave unset for Micro-C.
regions.help_text: When set, balancing is restricted to the captured regions via a blacklist of everything else (written to `<outdir>/beds/`), exactly as in the original pipeline.

split_fastq.description: Number of read pairs per alignment chunk. Set to 0 to align each lane as a single job.
split_fastq.help_text: Chunks are aligned in parallel and re-joined in their original read order before sorting, so results are near-identical to aligning the whole lane at once. bwa-mem2 breaks ties between equally scoring alignments using the read's index in the input, so a very small number of chimeric reads can differ (on the demo data: 3 of 1.85M deduplicated pairs, one contact in the contact maps). Use `--split_fastq 0` to reproduce the original pipeline exactly.

qc_options.title: QC options
qc_options.description: Additional quality control steps (not part of the original pipeline).

skip_fastqc.description: Skip FastQC on the raw reads.

loop_calling_options.title: Loop calling options (mustache)
loop_calling_options.description: Loop calling with mustache on the condition-merged contact maps.

mustache_resolutions.description: Comma-separated resolutions (bp) to call loops at. Must be a subset of `--resolutions`.

mustache_pt.description: mustache `-pt`: FDR threshold for reported loops.

mustache_distance.description: mustache `-d`: maximum loop distance in bp (mustache picks a resolution-dependent default, capped at 2 Mb).

mustache_norm.description: mustache `-norm`: balancing weight column to use (mustache default: `weight`).

mustache_chromosomes.description: Comma-separated chromosomes to call loops on (overrides the automatic selection).
mustache_chromosomes.help_text: By default all chromosomes in `--chromsizes` longer than `--mustache_min_chrom_size` and not in `--mustache_exclude_chroms` are used (mustache's own whole-genome behaviour). In RCMC mode only chromosomes containing capture regions are used.

mustache_exclude_chroms.description: Comma-separated chromosomes never used for loop calling.

mustache_min_chrom_size.description: Minimum chromosome length (bp) for automatic loop calling (mustache skips chromosomes <= 1 Mb).

mustache_allow_failure.description: If mustache/diff_mustache fails on a chromosome (non-signal exit), write an empty loop file and log a warning instead of failing the pipeline.

differential_loop_options.title: Differential loop options (diff_mustache)
differential_loop_options.description: Optional differential loop detection between conditions.

diff_loops.description: Run diff_mustache between conditions (all pairwise unless `--contrasts` is given).

diff_mustache_pt2.description: diff_mustache `-pt2`: FDR threshold for differential loops.

institutional_config_options.title: Institutional config options
institutional_config_options.description: Parameters used to describe centralised config profiles. These should not be edited.
institutional_config_options.help_text: The centralised nf-core configuration profiles use a handful of pipeline parameters to describe themselves. This information is then printed to the Nextflow log when you run a pipeline. You should not need to change these values when you run a pipeline.

custom_config_version.description: Git commit id for Institutional configs.

custom_config_base.help_text: If you're running offline, Nextflow will not be able to fetch the institutional config files from the internet. If you don't need them, then this is not a problem. If you do need them, you should download the files from the repo and tell Nextflow where to find them with this parameter.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline, typically set in a config file.
generic_options.help_text:
These options are common to all nf-core pipelines and allow you to customise some of the core preferences for how the pipeline runs.

Typically these options would be set in a Nextflow config file loaded for all pipeline runs, such as `~/.nextflow/config`.

publish_dir_mode.description: Method used to save pipeline results to output directory.
publish_dir_mode.help_text: The Nextflow `publishDir` option specifies which intermediate files should be saved to the output directory. This option tells the pipeline what method should be used to move these files. See [Nextflow docs](https://www.nextflow.io/docs/latest/process.html#publishdir) for details.

email_on_fail.description: Email address for completion summary, only when pipeline fails.
email_on_fail.help_text: An email address to send a summary email to when the pipeline is completed - ONLY sent if the pipeline does not exit successfully.

plaintext_email.description: Send plain-text email instead of HTML.

max_multiqc_email_size.description: File size limit when attaching MultiQC reports to summary emails.

monochrome_logs.description: Do not use coloured log outputs.

multiqc_config.description: Custom config file to supply to MultiQC.

multiqc_logo.description: Custom logo file to supply to MultiQC. File name must also be set in the MultiQC config file

multiqc_methods_description.description: Custom MultiQC yaml file containing HTML including a methods description.

validate_params.description: Boolean whether to validate parameters against the schema at runtime

pipelines_testdata_base_path.description: Base URL or local path to location of pipeline test dataset files

trace_report_suffix.description: Suffix to add to the trace report filename. Default is the date and time in the format yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm-ss.

help_full.description: Display the full detailed help message.

show_hidden.description: Display hidden parameters in the help message (only works when --help or --help_full are provided).
